name: Low-End PC Survival Pack

os_settings: Visual effects: Adjust for best performance
driver_settings: NVIDIA: Low Latency Mode = Ultra (if supported)
background_processes: Disable Windows Search indexing during gameplay

revert_steps: Set Windows Power Plan back to Balanced
Re-enable visual effects: System Properties > Advanced > Performance Settings
Re-enable background apps: Settings > Privacy > Background apps
Resume Windows Update: Settings > Update & Security
Reset GPU driver settings to default in control panel
warnings: Visual quality will be significantly reduced
Some games may look blurry with resolution scaling
Performance varies greatly by specific hardware
Integrated graphics (Intel UHD/Vega) will still struggle with AAA titles
notes: Designed for systems barely meeting minimum requirements. Prioritizes stability and playability over visual quality. Best suited for competitive games where framerate matters more than graphics.
